# DrawnUI

> Hardware-accelerated rendering engine powered by Skia, used along the framework you already have, not instead of it. Draws pixel-perfect UI on a Skia canvas. DrawnUI for .NET (SkiaSharp) runs on .NET MAUI, Blazor, pure WebAssembly, OpenTK, WPF and other .NET hosts; DrawnUI for React and DrawnUI for Rust share the same controls and rules (sections below). Open source: https://github.com/DrawnUi/DrawnUi.Net

## Skills (for AI Agents)

Save under `~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (or your agent's skill folder) to teach your agent DrawnUI. Some skills are multi-file bundles — if a SKILL.md links to `references/*.md`, fetch those alongside it into the same folder, keeping the relative paths.

- [DrawnUI framework skill](https://drawnui.net/skills/drawnui/SKILL.md): controls, layouts, caching, gestures, virtualization — deep framework guidance
- [DrawnUI fluent C# skill](https://drawnui.net/skills/drawnui-fluent/SKILL.md): fluent code-behind composition patterns for building UI in C#
- [DrawnUI game dev skill](https://drawnui.net/skills/drawnui-game/SKILL.md): games on DrawnUi.Gaming.DrawnGame — game loop, sprite pooling, collision, input, MAUI+Blazor project templates, WASM startup optimization
- [DrawnUI web app skill](https://drawnui.net/skills/drawnui-web-app/SKILL.md): scaffold pure-WebAssembly DrawnUi.Web apps, shared-source projects, hot reload, WASM runtime bug hunting
- [DrawnUI Blazor skill](https://drawnui.net/skills/drawnui-blazor/SKILL.md): Blazor WASM apps — startup, gestures, rendering modes, single-thread divergences, font subsetting, GitHub Pages publishing
- [DrawnUI OpenTK skill](https://drawnui.net/skills/drawnui-opentk/SKILL.md): desktop apps — DrawnUiWindow, CanvasHost GL overlays, update modes, window chrome/icon, Linux fixes, instant desktop test harness
- [DrawnUI headless testing skill](https://drawnui.net/skills/drawnui-net-harness/SKILL.md): pure-.NET headless harness — render frames offscreen, simulate gestures, reproduce scroll/virtualization bugs without a device
- [SkiaSharp SKMesh skill](https://drawnui.net/skills/skmech/SKILL.md): experimental SKMesh custom mesh drawing with SkSL — spec/buffers/DrawMesh, WASM trimming and backend traps. Bundle — also fetch [references/api-overview.md](https://drawnui.net/skills/skmech/references/api-overview.md) and [references/examples.md](https://drawnui.net/skills/skmech/references/examples.md)
- [Fiddle driving skill](https://drawfiddle.com/skills/drawnui-fiddle/SKILL.md): drive the in-browser playground programmatically (window.fiddle API)

## DrawnUI for React

DrawnUI for React (npm `drawnui-react`) is the same engine in TypeScript on CanvasKit (Skia WASM) for the web, composed with React through a custom `react-reconciler`. Same control names and PascalCase API as the .NET version, early prototype.

- [DrawnUI for React overview](https://drawnui.net/articles/react/index.html)
- [Source](https://github.com/DrawnUi/DrawnUi.React)
- [Live demo](https://helloreact.drawnui.net)
- [DrawnUI React skill](https://helloreact.drawnui.net/skills/drawnui-react/SKILL.md): install, startup, composition rules for agents

## DrawnUI for Rust

DrawnUI for Rust (crate `drawnui`) is the same engine in Rust on Skia (rust-skia), for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android and the browser (WebAssembly). Same controls and rules as the .NET version, with Rust names and fluent builders, preview.

- [DrawnUI for Rust overview](https://drawnui.net/articles/rust/index.html)
- [Source](https://github.com/DrawnUi/DrawnUi.Rust)
- [Crate](https://crates.io/crates/drawnui) and [API docs](https://docs.rs/drawnui)
- [Live demo](https://hellorust.drawnui.net)
- [DrawnUI Rust skill](https://hellorust.drawnui.net/skills/drawnui-rust/SKILL.md): adding the crate, the browser build, the web page, Android, Linux, for agents

## Try it live

- [DrawnUI Fiddle](https://drawfiddle.com/): in-browser C# playground — Roslyn compiles on WebAssembly, renders live on a DrawnUI canvas. AI-drivable, has its own [llms.txt](https://drawfiddle.com/llms.txt).
